title: Hurford Youth Fellows Program
about: Four-month fellowship (1 May to 31 August 2027) at the National Endowment for Democracy in Washington, D.C., for applicants aged 30 or younger committed to youth participation in democracy. Up to three fellows are selected. Recommendation letters are due 4 December 2026.
requirements: Demonstrated commitment to youth participation in democracy
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Hurford Youth Fellows Program at the National Endowment for Democracy (NED), Washington, D.C., United States, deadline 30 November 2026. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Empire State Building in New York City, not Washington, D.C.
